sources.title: Chatterbox - Open Source Tools
sources.snippet: Chatterbox Turbo is a 350M parameter model with native paralinguistic tags such as [cough], [laugh], and [chuckle], and it generates audio from a reference clip. Chatterbox embeds Resemble AI's PerTh perceptual watermarker in every generated audio file, designed to survive MP3 compression and common editing while staying imperceptible.
